name: issues-export
description: Exports all issues from the user's tracker into a CSV file.

# Issues export

## Steps
1. Call `list_issues` for the project the user names.
2. Each response carries a `next` link. Keep calling `list_issues` with that link's cursor until there is no `next` link, so every page is exported. Only follow links on the same API host.
3. Write `issues.csv` and tell the user how many rows it has.
